purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) processing system — specifically the ORCA (JMA standard receipt software) subsystem for public-injury (公害) inpatient receipt basic information processing
purpose.summary: ORCR1200 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that processes public-injury (公害) inpatient receipt records. It reads indexed receipt detail files (RECE200, RECE250), performs insurance combination and hospitalization history lookups, and writes error records. It handles special cases such as same-day re-admission and other-insurance history.

notable_features: 36 COPY statements referencing ORCA-specific copybooks (CPRCF200.INC, CPRCF250.INC, CPHKNCOMBI.INC, etc.)
LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM parsed via UNSTRING
INDEXED file I/O with DYNAMIC access mode
OCCURS tables for insurance combinations and day-count tracking
Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments (decoded as latin-1 garbled)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — uses MCP (middleware) DB access layer
REPLACING clause on COPY for record aliasing
210 PERFORM statements indicating structured procedural decomposition
verdict.notes: Source comments are in Japanese EUC-JP encoding but the file was decoded as latin-1, resulting in garbled multi-byte characters in comment lines. The code itself is valid COBOL. File is truncated at 16000 chars out of 115678 bytes (2640 lines total), but enough is visible to classify confidently. The MCP (Master Control Program) abstraction layer is characteristic of the JMA ORCA open-source medical system running on GnuCOBOL/Linux.
